common_required_evidence.name: authorized_source_and_use_rights
common_required_evidence.purpose: Source provenance, de-identification and intended model-training use permission

common_required_evidence.name: upstream_ml_result
common_required_evidence.purpose: Actual upstream model output, algorithm/version, run ID, score semantics, candidate ranking and referenced evidence

common_required_evidence.name: diagnostic_logs
common_required_evidence.purpose: Time-stamped logs with original time basis, event identifiers and immutable source locators

common_required_evidence.name: spacecraft_configuration
common_required_evidence.purpose: As-flown/as-tested subsystem and component configuration relevant to the event

common_required_evidence.name: mission_phase_and_operating_mode
common_required_evidence.purpose: Mission phase, operating mode, command/telemetry mode and relevant constraints at event time

common_required_evidence.name: time_alignment_and_measurement_dictionary
common_required_evidence.purpose: Parameter names, physical measurement points, units, calibration/validity and time alignment

common_required_evidence.name: disposal_execution_and_verification
common_required_evidence.purpose: Separate recorded recommendation/procedure, actual command/action execution and post-action effect verification

common_required_evidence.name: independent_expert_reviews
common_required_evidence.purpose: Two independent reviews and adjudication for material disagreements

case_specific.name: current_and_main_error_voltage_drops
case_specific.purpose: Original time series/logs for the three reported drops; event timestamps and channel identity

case_specific.name: temperature_measurement_points
case_specific.purpose: Exact sensor locations and definitions for the reported 181°C shaft temperature and 150°C housing temperature

case_specific.name: solar_array_stall_and_angle_adjustment
case_specific.purpose: Command, drive-state and stall chronology during south solar-array angle adjustment

case_specific.name: slip_ring_brush_arc_evidence
case_specific.purpose: Inspection, test, maintenance or fault-analysis evidence supporting debris-induced arc in the disc-ring/brush power path

case_specific.name: south_array_shutdown_execution
case_specific.purpose: Whether the recorded shutdown was commanded/executed, timestamp and subsequent status

case_specific.name: helix_current_power_temperature_chronology
case_specific.purpose: Time-aligned helix current, RF output power, TWTA A/EPC A/isolator A temperatures, microwave and triplexer temperatures

case_specific.name: cable_isolator_connection_evidence
case_specific.purpose: Inspection/contact resistance/connector state and high-power reflection evidence at the cable-to-isolator input

case_specific.name: meaning_of_self_recovery
case_specific.purpose: Source record defining whether the phenomenon cleared without ground action, and what operational verification followed

case_specific.name: post_recovery_validation
case_specific.purpose: Subsequent power, current and temperature trend confirming whether normal operation persisted

case_specific.name: EPDF_overpower_dissipation_evidence
case_specific.purpose: Actual EPDF state/telemetry, protection status and diagnostic evidence for the stated cause

case_specific.name: helix_current_and_auto_shutdown_timeline
case_specific.purpose: Timestamped current rise, protection trigger (if any), automatic shutdown and restart

case_specific.name: conditional_branch_state_mapping
case_specific.purpose: Original logic/state table mapping the three disposal branches to protection-triggered, not-shutdown and automatic-shutdown states

case_specific.name: backup_switch_restart_preheat_execution
case_specific.purpose: Actual switch, restart and ten-cycle preheat records if performed; otherwise preserve as conditional procedure

case_specific.name: post_restart_stability
case_specific.purpose: Continuous operation/verification after restart

case_specific.name: minus_33C_sensor_definition
case_specific.purpose: Physical location, sensor identity, units and validity for the reported 2# thruster temperature

case_specific.name: prior_high_temperature_and_maneuver_timeline
case_specific.purpose: Previous-day high-temperature event and completion of attitude maneuver with timestamps

case_specific.name: thrust_measurement_basis
case_specific.purpose: Whether thrust reduction came from direct measurement, estimate or inferred telemetry, with calibration and uncertainty

case_specific.name: wheel_speed_and_attitude_time_series
case_specific.purpose: Time-aligned wheel 1/2 speeds, roll/pitch errors and 0.6-degree attitude-error alarm

case_specific.name: combustion_and_structural_damage_evidence
case_specific.purpose: Evidence for incomplete-combustion product accumulation, abnormal combustion and alleged thruster structural damage

case_specific.name: control_strategy_reconfiguration
case_specific.purpose: What was changed, when, by which command/procedure and measured effect

case_specific.name: shaft_temperature_time_series
case_specific.purpose: Timestamped 27°C, 50.27°C and 74.2°C readings, sensor location, operating state and measurement validity

case_specific.name: lubrication_feedline_blockage_evidence
case_specific.purpose: Inspection, disassembly, maintenance or test evidence for blockage and bearing oil starvation

case_specific.name: bearing_friction_evidence
case_specific.purpose: Current, torque, speed, vibration or other evidence supporting increased bearing friction

case_specific.name: wheel_configuration_switch_execution
case_specific.purpose: Actual configuration command/state change and time

case_specific.name: 2000rpm_limit_status
case_specific.purpose: Distinguish recommendation from approved constraint, command execution and telemetry showing actual speed limitation
